subject.title: Harden FakeCo auth, Slack-off mode, and ALB logout

question: After the code defect is repaired, must this PR show live AWS/Cognito/ALB deployment proof before merge, or is automated-only proof explicitly accepted for repository landing?
rationale: The PR body claims an authorized exception, but the visible discussion contains no attributable maintainer decision or proof-override signal that automation can safely rely on.

options.title: Require live AWS proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted evidence demonstrates the real Cognito claim, Slack-off stack update, listener routing, and logout-cookie behavior.

options.title: Record a proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept automated-only repository landing while retaining mandatory live proof before the FakeCo deployment is dispatched or called live.

recommendation.title: Require live AWS proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted evidence demonstrates the real Cognito claim, Slack-off stack update, listener routing, and logout-cookie behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the merged AWS, FakeCo, and Slack-delivery history and is the best available routing candidate, although git history alone does not establish final repository authority.
